Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is commonly known as y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
LoanedTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is a Brazilian footballer.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
FoesPlay(x, y) ::: x foes not play for y.

Premises:
BornIn(ailtonSilva, 1995) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
KnownAs(ailtonSilva, ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
LoanedTo(ailtonSilva, braga) ::: Ailton is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
Brazilian(ailtonSilva) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
PlaysFor(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.

Conclusion:
